name: KnowWhere Memory
description: Fractal memory layer for OpenClaw. Retrieves relevant memories before each prompt and stores session context. E2E verified 2026-03-29.

apiKey.description: KnowWhere API key (if authentication is enabled)

autoRecall.description: Automatically retrieve relevant memories before each prompt

autoCapture.description: Automatically store session transcripts after each agent run

topK.description: Maximum number of memories to retrieve per query

importLookbackDays.description: Import session messages from the last N days on gateway startup

minSessionSizeBytes.description: Skip sessions smaller than this on import (filters out heartbeat/noise)
